data.title: NevGold Announces Graduation to the TSX Senior Board
data.description:
Vancouver, British Columbia, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- NevGold Corp. (TSX-V: NAU) OTCQX:NAUFF Frankfurt:5E50 (“NevGold” or the “Company“) is pleased to announce that the Company will graduate from the TSX Venture Exchange to the senior board Toronto Stock Exchange (the “TSX”) and the common shares of the Company will commence trading on the TSX at the opening of the market on or about December 1, 2026 under its current symbol “NAU”.

CEO, Brandon Bonifacio states “Since forming NevGold and completing our public listing in 2021, we have transformed the Company from an early-stage explorer into a well-funded developer with a portfolio of highly prospective gold, antimony, and copper assets in the Western United States. Our graduation to the TSX from the TSX Venture Exchange is a significant achievement that reflects the hard work of our team and the substantial progress we have made in building shareholder value.

Listing on Canada’s premier senior exchange represents an important milestone in NevGold’s evolution and positions the Company for its next phase of growth. We expect the TSX listing to increase our visibility among institutional and retail investors globally, expand access to capital, and further enhance our standing within the investment community.

As we continue advancing our flagship projects, particularly at a time when domestic sources of critical minerals such as antimony are becoming increasingly strategic, we remain committed to executing our long-term growth strategy and progressing toward becoming a leading emerging gold and antimony producer in North America.”

The Company has received final approval from the TSX for the listing of its common shares. In connection with the listing, the common shares will be voluntarily delisted from the TSX Venture Exchange upon the commencement of trading on the main TSX board.

The Company’s trading symbol will remain “NAU” upon the commencement of trading on the main TSX board. The CUSIP and ISIN will also remain unchanged. Shareholders are not required to take any action in connection with the Company’s graduation to the TSX, and existing share certificates and direct registration statements will continue to represent Nevgold’s common shares.

In connection with the listing on the TSX, the Company has reconstituted its audit committee to consist of Victor Bradley, Sean Waller and Scott Bensing, each of which is independent as determined under National Instrument 52-110 – Audit Committees. Victor Bradley has been appointed as the lead independent director of the Company.

About the Company

NevGold is dedicated to discovering, de-risking, and rapidly advancing gold and critical metals projects across premier jurisdictions in Nevada and Idaho to drive shareholder value and strengthen US mineral security. The Company holds a 100% interest in the Limousine Butte (gold-antimony) and Cedar Wash (gold) projects in Nevada, and the Nutmeg Mountain (gold) and Zeus (copper) projects in Idaho. For more information, please visit www.nev-gold.com.

ON BEHALF OF THE BOARD

“Signed”

Brandon Bonifacio, President & CEO

For further information, please contact Brandon Bonifacio at bbonifacio@nev-gold.com, call 604-337-5033, or visit our website at www.nev-gold.com.

data.title: Amazon, Target and Walmart Chase Holiday Toy Spending
data.description:
Amazon (AMZN, Financials), Walmart and Target are competing for holiday shoppers as demand for sensory toys, gaming consoles and consumer electronics shapes Black Friday shopping trends.

Squishy collectible toys rank among the most popular items at Amazon and Target, while interactive products and artificial intelligence-powered toys are also attracting consumer interest.

The $130 Stickerbox uses artificial intelligence to generate custom sticker designs, while the Primal Hatch megalodon toy is available at Amazon, Walmart and Target, with Amazon offering it for $35.

Consumer electronics remain a significant category for holiday retailers. According to the Consumer Technology Association, at least 87% of adults plan to purchase technology gifts this holiday season.

Popular electronics include Apple's AirPods 5, Sony cameras and Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses.

Nintendo's $500 Switch 2 console also ranks among bestselling products at Amazon, Target and Best Buy, reflecting continued demand for gaming hardware.

Meanwhile, Mattel is expanding its KPop Demon Hunters toy lineup, while Disney is offering figurines based on its Toy Story franchise.

Investors will monitor Black Friday and Cyber Monday sales for indications of consumer spending strength, retail demand and fourth-quarter revenue performance.

data.title: ChronoScale Holdings shares skyrocket, what you need to know
data.description:
What happened?

Shares of ChronoScale Holdings jumped 3.2% in the morning session after broad U.S. equity indexes rallied on a technology-led rebound that signaled a potential return of investor risk appetite.

CNBC reported that the Dow Jones Industrial Average edged higher by 1.18%, or 591.99 points, to close at 50,774.94, while the S&P 500 edged higher by 1.6% to 7,297.49 and the Nasdaq Composite climbed 2.31% to 24,129.50.

According to the report, technology stocks supported the advance, with Meta Platforms rising more than 3%, Amazon rising about 4%, Broadcom rising almost 4% and Anthropic soaring nearly 11%. The report also showed that the VIX volatility index, a gauge of how much the S&P 500 might move in the next 30 days based on options trading, pulled back to 25.13.

When major indexes rally and volatility eases, improving investor appetite for risk can lift stocks across technology-adjacent industries. Broad market advances often attract buyers back to shares that move in line with overall equity sentiment.

After the initial pop, the shares cooled down and closed the day at $10.06, up 4.5% from the previous close.

What is the market telling us

ChronoScale Holdings’s shares are extremely volatile and have had 112 moves greater than 5% over the last year. In that context, today’s move indicates the market considers this news meaningful but not something that would fundamentally change its perception of the business.

The previous big move we wrote about was 4 days ago when the stock gained 17.2% on the news that Nvidia announced the reinstatement of Jensen Huang as president and CEO, sparking renewed investor confidence across artificial intelligence and semiconductor markets following the previous week's sharp downturn.

The leadership news lifted broader market indexes as investors stepped back into artificial intelligence and data center operators, reversing a steep retreat that had recently pushed major market benchmarks into correction territory. A market correction occurs when an index declines by 10 percent or more from its recent peak, underscoring the severity of the prior sell-off. Technology and semiconductor shares led the advance during early trading, signaling that investor sentiment has stabilized across the wider chip ecosystem.

ChronoScale Holdings is up 40.6% since the beginning of the year, but at $11.03 per share, it is still trading 62.8% below its 52-week high of $29.63 from July 2026. Despite the year-to-date gain, investors who bought $1,000 worth of ChronoScale Holdings’s shares 5 years ago would now be looking at only $218.75.

ONE MORE THING: 3 Hidden Platforms Growing 3X Faster than Amazon, Google, and PayPal. Amazon, Google, and Meta all followed the same playbook: Dominate an ignored market. Build an unbeatable moat. Scale until you’re unstoppable.

These three platforms are running that exact playbook right now. The early investors in Amazon made fortunes. The early investors in these could do the same.

data.title: Oil Futures Settle Lower Ahead of OPEC+ Policy Meeting — 2nd Update
data.description:
By Farhan Rafid and Anthony Harrup

Oil futures settled lower Friday with traders weighing renewed threats to Middle Eastern supplies and awaiting a weekend meeting of the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries and its allies to discuss output policy for 2027.

Brent crude for January delivery fell 1.2% to $95.44 a barrel, ending the week up 3.1% and snapping a three-week losing streak. West Texas Intermediate crude for January fell 0.7% to $83.08 a barrel and was down a 0.4% from a week earlier, a fourth consecutive weekly loss.

Saudi Arabia's energy ministry said Thursday that an attack on the Jazan oil refinery sparked a fire and temporarily halted some operations. Authorities were assessing the damage and checking the safety of the facilities, the ministry said.

Meanwhile, an Iranian drone attack in Kuwait killed two Italian technicians, The Wall Street Journal reported. Iran denied responsibility for the attack, which comes as negotiations between Washington and Tehran remain deadlocked despite a ceasefire.

"Prices had been under pressure for roughly four weeks as the market leaned into surplus talk," Price Futures Group senior market analyst Phil Flynn said in a note. But attacks on Saudi infrastructure and continued incidents around the Strait of Hormuz have put risk premium back, he added.

Oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz remain at just 31% of prewar levels, according to preliminary data from Kpler. While Iraqi crude exports remain relatively strong, delays to some November and December cargoes have raised concerns over the reliability of near-term Middle Eastern supplies, Alex Booth, head of research at the data provider, said.

OPEC and other producers in the broader group called OPEC+ are expected to discuss their collective output policy for 2027 on Sunday, with existing production agreements set to expire at the end of this year.

The group's assessment of members' sustainable production capacities will help determine individual output quotas for next year. However, disruptions to production and exports during the Iran war have complicated efforts to establish how much individual countries can pump.

It remains unclear whether Saudi Arabia--the cartel's de-facto leader--and other members will restore more supply, maintain current restrictions or consider fresh cuts to support prices.

The impact on oil prices of Sunday's OPEC+ meeting is likely to be tempered by the outlook for the regional conflict, analysts at MUFG said in a note Friday.

The meeting could end without a final decision, leaving current production quotas in place for the time being, Commerzbank analyst Barbara Lambrecht said. With the exception of Iraq, most OPEC+ members are producing well below their existing quotas, while some countries, including Russia, are unable to increase output further, she said.

"Long-running tensions within the group may surface over output quota decisions," and disputes among members could weaken the group's pricing power, Capital Economics senior climate and commodities economist Hamad Hussain said in a note. "A more fractious and less cohesive OPEC+ will lead to greater oil price volatility and skew the balance of risks towards lower oil prices over time."

Write to Farhan Rafid at farhan.rafid@wsj.com and Anthony Harrup at anthony.harrup@wsj.com

data.title: Soybeans rally on rising Brazilian real, soymeal
data.description:
By Heather Schlitz

Chicago Board of Trade soybean futures rallied to a one-month high on Friday under support from a climbing Brazilian real, higher soymeal futures and a steady drip of export demand for US soybeans.

Corn and wheat futures also ticked higher under spillover support from soybeans.

Chicago Board of Trade January soybeans rose 22-1/4 cents to $12.66-1/4 a bushel, while March corn gained 6-1/2 cents to $4.63 per bushel.

Brazilian assets rallied ​on Friday after President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva tapped a market-friendly bank executive to be his next finance ‌chief, following weeks of investor concern over the fiscal direction of the leftist leader's upcoming fourth term.

Export demand for soybeans has also been steady.

The US Department of Agriculture on Friday morning reported net weekly export sales of 755,800 metric tons of soybeans. The agency also reported a sale of 132,000 metric tons of soybeans to the Netherlands for 2026/2027 delivery in its daily reporting system on Friday morning.

Trade volume has been relatively light between Thursday's Thanksgiving holiday and the weekend. Grain markets were closed for Thanksgiving and traded for an abbreviated session on Friday.

Investors are weighing whether exports to China will be affected, as the top soy importer was already on pace to meet its annual purchasing commitment, while a disappointing harvest in South America could shift demand toward US soybeans.

The two countries are continuing to work on resolving agricultural trade issues.

The soy complex continued to receive support from soaring soymeal futures, which have continued to shoot higher on expectations that EU demand could rise due to the bloc's new deforestation rules that are set to take effect in late December.

CBOT March wheat settled 3-1/2 cents higher at $5.91 per bushel as traders assessed the ongoing conflict in the Black Sea.

Ukraine has offered a Black Sea ceasefire to enable food exports and passed this on to international allies, Kyiv's foreign minister Andrii Sybiha said on Friday.

data.title: TSLA Stock Clocks Best Week In 18 Months: Tesla Reportedly Eyes Buying German Toolmaker Amid Cybercab, Optimus Scaling Plans
data.description:
Key points:
  • EMAG designs and builds precision equipment for turning, grinding, and gear cutting, primarily serving the automotive industry. 
  • The company has also developed specialized systems for manufacturing high-precision gears used in humanoid robot actuators. 
  • Tesla, meanwhile, has begun early production of its Optimus humanoid robots at its production line at its Fremont factory.

Shares of EV giant Tesla (TSLA) rose on Friday, adding to a strong weekly performance, as the company reportedly plans to acquire Germany-based machine-tool maker EMAG.

TSLA stock started the short Thanksgiving week strong, thanks to a tech rally driven by the reinstatement of Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO in less than two weeks of his ouster. The stock clocked small losses in the following two days, before jumping on Friday.

TSLA stock was up more than 5% at market close. It has gained nearly 16% overall this week, with anticipation for a deal between the company and SpaceX adding optimism, clocking its best week since May 2025, according to Koyfin data.

Tesla Eyes German Machine Maker

Tesla submitted plans to Germany’s competition authority without providing details of the transaction, Automotive World reported on Friday. The filing follows Tesla’s registration of Tesla Machining Technologies Management SE, a shell company renamed from an August entry, with its address at EMAG’s headquarters in Salach near Stuttgart, the report noted.

EMAG designs and builds precision equipment for turning, grinding, and gear cutting, primarily serving the automotive industry by producing machines that make drivetrain components such as transmissions and related parts. The company has also developed specialized systems for manufacturing high-precision gears used in humanoid robot actuators.

Deal Talks As Tesla Ramps Up Cybercab, Optimus Production

The news comes as Tesla has started early production of its Optimus humanoid robots at a production line at its Fremont factory, designed for up to one million units a year. On the third-quarter (Q3) earnings call, CEO Elon Musk reiterated that the hand of the robot is the main hardware challenge. The company is aiming to deliver the robots to external customers starting in late 2027.

Tesla’s sole European vehicle plant in Grünheide, Brandenburg, currently builds Model Y vehicles at roughly 375,000 annual capacity. The company recently announced a first €3 billion investment in the factory to produce up to one million Cybercab robotaxis a year there as well, with construction targeted for 2027 and production from 2029. Cybercab production is currently limited to the company’s factory in Texas.

How Did TSLA Retail Traders React?

On Stocktwits, retail sentiment around TSLA stock stayed within ‘bullish’ territory over the past 24 hours, while message volume stayed at ‘low’ levels.

TSLA stock has dropped 11% year-to-date.

data.title: Crude Oil Slides As Trump Offers More Time For Diplomacy To Resolve Iran Crisis
data.description:
WASHINGTON (dpa-AFX) - Crude oil prices have moved lower on Friday as near-term war concerns eased after U.S. President Donald Trump stated that he prefers to give Iran more opportunity to strike a deal with the U.S. However, supply concerns due to incidents of ship attacks in the Strait of Hormuz and Houthi-Saudi Arabia conflict restricted the decline.

WTI Crude Oil for January delivery was last seen trading down by $0.67 (or 0.80%) at $83.01 per barrel.

In his Thanksgiving address at his residence in Florida, Trump remarked that victory in the war with Iran would be achieved whenever he wants it.

Trump stated that he is giving another chance for Iran to act smart but he sounded skeptical if the present Iranian regime would utilize the offer. Trump wanted Iran to use this opportunity to decide wisely and save a lot of lives.

Re-asserting again that Iran can never be allowed to have a nuclear weapon, Trump warned that Iranian missiles can reach up to Europe.

Trump threatened that if no deal is reached with Iran, further U.S. attacks on Iran could even target the strategic Pickaxe Mountain where Iran is suspected of piling up enriched nuclear materials.

Though no signs of de-escalation has emerged, market participants are counting on the remarks by Trump last week when he stated that he preferred to wait and watch how negotiations with Iran unfolds until January 1.

Trump had stressed that he is not in any rush to take a decision on Iran.

Iraq is now seeking an allowance to raise its production capacity and quota baselines from the Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries.

Iraq's oil minister Basim Mohammed Khudair Al-Abadi stated that Iraq raised its oil exports to 3.60 million barrels per day.

Iraq is the second largest producer of the OPEC alliance. Al-Abadi added that Iraq is in discussions with major U.S. oil firms including ExxonMobil, Chevron, and ConocoPhillips regarding potential investments in several oilfields.

Reports indicate that the OPEC cartel will likely keep the production targets unchanged in its meeting on November 29.

Meanwhile, Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps continued to announce incidents of ships hitting naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz after they violated Iran's guidelines for navigation.

Iran's Fars news agency cited the IRGC as stating that while one oil tanker exploded, another tanker was forced to turn back. Reportedly, the two oil tankers attempted to secretly pass through an unauthorized route north of Ghavam Island.

While flows from the region picked up, global oil consumption has moved lower.

Late Thursday, Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated that Qatar and Pakistan are carrying proposals between Iran and the U.S. Araghchi added that though Iran was reviewing several ideas presented before it, the nation stood by its conditions for reopening the Strait of Hormuz.

Aside from the U.S.-Iran standoff, the flare-up in the strikes between Saudi Arabia and Iran-supported Houthi militant group of Yemen renewed supply concerns.

The Houthis are targeting the oil-rich Kingdom of Saudi Arabia almost on a daily basis, targeting energy facilities, airports, and financial infrastructures in Riyadh.

Qatar strongly condemned the Houthi attacks and expressed full solidarity with Saudi Arabia.

In retaliation to the deadly Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura refinery, the Saudi Arabia led coalition fighting the group struck areas in Yemen.

According to energy experts, the release of a report on global oil demand outlook by Paris-based International Energy Agency on November 13, indicating an impending global supply glut is pressuring oil prices on the downside. The release highlighted that oil markets would shift back into a surplus in the fourth quarter of 2026.

The U.S. dollar index was last seen trading at 104.04, up by 0.38 (or 0.37%) today.

data.title: Brazil leads LatAm higher as Lula taps Bradesco chairman for finance chief
data.description:
Key points:
  • MSCI LatAm stock index up 3.2%, FX up 2.3%
  • Trabuco appointment lifts Brazil assets
  • Copper gains place Chile on solid footing
  • EM bond outflows ease for second-straight week, JPM says

By Niket Nishant and Johann M Cherian

Most Latin American assets advanced on Friday, with the currencies index on track for its biggest weekly jump since August 2024, led by gains in Brazil after Bradesco Chairman Luiz Carlos Trabuco was appointed as the country's finance chief.

The gains could help regional stocks recover some poise at the end of a tumultuous month marked by a global risk-off mood as concerns about the AI trade intensified.

MSCI's index of regional equities (.MILA00000PUS) added 3.2% and was on track for its biggest weekly gain in more than a month, while the corresponding currency gauge (.MILA00000CUS) rose 2.3%. Weekly gains for the currencies index were just short of advances seen last in late-October 2022.

Brazilian stocks rose as much as 4% as President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva tapped Trabuco, a market-friendly bank executive, to be his finance chief. Trabuco is expected to have a say in discussions over additional fiscal measures currently under consideration, an official said.

The index was last up 0.1%, limited by a 2.7% loss each in state-owned commodities companies Petrobras and Vale .

The real strengthened 2.2% versus the dollar and was set for its fifth consecutive day of gains, its longest winning streak since April. At 7.6%, it was poised for its strongest week since May 2020.

International bonds also gained broadly, with those maturing in 2054 (105756CJ7=) and 2050 (105756CB4=) up more than 2 cents on the dollar.

"The appointment is encouraging and reinforces our view that Brazil does not need everything to turn positive to rebound. Sustaining a re-rating, however, requires fiscal delivery and execution," Jefferies analysts said.

COPPER RALLY LIFTS CHILEAN ASSETS

Chilean stocks (.MMXIPSAGC) rose 1.7%, while the peso strengthened 1%. Price of copper, the country's top export item, rallied on Friday, posting its biggest gain since January.

Data from statistics agency INE showed unemployment rate hit 10% in the quarter through October, above the 9.8% expected by economists polled by Reuters.

Peruvian equities (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) rose 2.8% and the sol was up 0.2%.

"Peru remains one of our preferred structural stories, with relatively resilient growth despite lower commodity prices and El Nino driving near-term noise. Chile is more of a 2027-28 investment story," Jefferies said.

In Mexico, the stock index jumped 2% and the peso gained 0.2%. The economy posted a $2.1 billion trade surplus in October when adjusted for seasonal swings, the national statistics agency said.

Separately, Mexico filed a formal complaint with the United States over a US Drug Enforcement Administration tip line seeking information on suspected drug traffickers and allegedly corrupt Mexican officials, President Claudia Sheinbaum said on Friday.

Colombia's peso appreciated 1.6% and local stocks added 1.6%.

Emerging-market bond outflows eased for a second consecutive week, according to data from JP Morgan.

Elsewhere in EM, ratings agency Moody's upgraded Vietnam's sovereign credit rating to "Ba1" from "Ba2", citing improvements in institutional quality and the country's shift toward higher-value growth.

data.title: How PrimeXBT’s TradingView Integration Helps Traders Navigate Always-on Crypto Markets
data.description:
Bitcoin can move sharply overnight, during a weekend or while a trader is away from their screen. By the time they check the price again, a level they were watching may already have been broken.

That is why alerts, technical indicators and tools for testing strategies have become important for monitoring price movements, analysing volatility and making informed trading decisions. As crypto markets have matured, traders have gained access to more sophisticated technology to navigate this 24/7 environment.

PrimeXBT, a global multi-asset broker and crypto asset service provider, has now integrated with TradingView, giving its clients access to these tools alongside the ability to place Crypto Futures and CFD trades directly from the TradingView platform, while benefiting from top-tier trading conditions and the flexibility to use crypto as trading capital.Why crypto traders need more than basic charts

Early crypto exchanges generally offered basic charts and order books, which meant traders looking for more detailed analysis often had to use separate charting tools. Today, they can examine multiple timeframes, add technical indicators and set price alerts, while historical testing tools help them assess strategies against earlier market conditions.

Traders often follow several coins at once, and price alerts notify them when a market reaches a chosen level. Historical charts also show how a strategy performed during previous rallies and sell-offs. With hundreds of coins and a growing range of derivatives, screeners let traders scan by price move, volume and technical conditions.

TradingView brings these capabilities together in a single analytical environment. Used by more than 100 million traders and investors worldwide, the platform covers cryptocurrencies alongside shares, forex, commodities and indices, allowing traders to analyse different markets using the same tools.

It offers 400+ built-in indicators and strategies, more than 100,000 public community indicators, and Pine Script for building custom indicators, strategies and alerts. Bar Replay rewinds the market to test an idea against past conditions, and its screeners cover crypto coins as well as pairs on centralised and decentralised exchanges.

Together, these tools help crypto traders monitor multiple markets, respond to price movements and evaluate strategies in an environment where volatility can emerge at any time.Trading crypto with PrimeXBT on TradingView

As a verified TradingView broker, PrimeXBT allows clients to connect an existing account or create one through the Trade panel and place orders directly from the TradingView platform. This connects advanced market analysis with trade execution in a single environment.

For example, a trader monitoring Bitcoin on a four-hour chart might identify a trading range and set alerts at both edges. When an alert is triggered, they can review the price movement, compare it with developments in gold and the US 500, and decide whether the conditions support a potential trade. If they choose to act, they can place the order through their connected PrimeXBT account without leaving TradingView.

PrimeXBT’s authorisation screen lists what TradingView can do on the account: open and manage orders, close active positions and check the balance, but it has no permission to withdraw funds.

PrimeXBT offers more than 350 instruments across Crypto Futures, Crypto CFDs and CFDs on forex, commodities, indices and shares, including more than 170 Crypto Futures markets. This allows crypto traders to explore opportunities across digital assets and traditional financial markets through a single account.

Crypto Futures on PXTrader 2.0 trade against a real order book with visible liquidity, while maker fees are 0.01% and taker fees start at 0.045%, falling as low as 0.015% through broker’s volume-based VIP tier program. CFD trading is commission-free with tight spreads. New clients also receive VIP 4 tier for their first 14 days, including a 33% discount on Crypto Futures taker fees and 25% on CFD spreads.

Clients can hold accounts in USD, USDT, USDC, BTC or ETH and fund them with crypto or fiat currency. This allows crypto traders to use digital assets as trading capital while accessing a broader range of financial markets. For example, clients holding Bitcoin can open an account in BTC and use that balance as margin collateral for CFD positions in markets such as gold or shares, without converting it to USD first.The Future of Crypto Trading: More Advanced and Connected

As crypto markets continue to mature, the ability to navigate round-the-clock volatility will remain a defining part of the trading experience. Technology is making it easier for traders to stay informed, assess opportunities and swiftly respond to market developments.

PrimeXBT’s integration with TradingView brings advanced analysis, trade execution together and top-tier trading conditions, helping shape a more connected and efficient trading experience for crypto traders navigating fast-moving markets.

About PrimeXBT

PrimeXBT is a global multi-asset broker and crypto asset service provider trusted by traders in more than 150 countries. The platform bridges traditional and digital markets within one integrated environment, redefining versatility and innovation in online trading. Clients can access Forex, CFDs on indices, commodities, shares, crypto, and Crypto Futures, as well as buy, store and exchange cryptocurrencies. This unified experience extends across both the native PXTrader 2.0 platform, MetaTrader 5 and TradingView, supported by advanced risk-management tools and a wide range of funding options in crypto, fiat and local payment methods. Since 2018, PrimeXBT has focused on empowering traders through broad multi-asset access, fair and transparent conditions, professional-grade technology and dedicated human support. data.title: vVARDIS and Henry Schein One Launch One-Click Auto Charting for Early-Stage Cavity Care
data.description:
vVARDIS (), the Swiss healthcare company in the dental med-tech sector offering non-invasive treatment for early-stage cavities, and Henry Schein One, a global leader in dental technology, today announced the launch of clinical auto-charting functionality for clinicians documenting early-stage cavities.

This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261127771676/en/

When a clinician detects an early-stage cavity, auto-charting features in Dentrix and Ascend record the code in the patient's chart with one click, reducing the charting process by 86%. The care team can then choose Curodont® to treat the tooth during the same visit, without duplicate documentation and with access to patient education resources regarding Curodont® within the platform. Throughout this workflow, treatment planning and decisions remain solely at the discretion of the clinician and patient.

The launch will represent the next phase of the collaboration between vVARDIS and Henry Schein One, which earlier this year introduced in-software awareness of Curodont® Repair Fluoride Plus to practices that use Dentrix and Ascend across the United States.

Tooth decay is the world’s most prevalent non-communicable disease, affecting approximately 2.5 billion people globally.1 A recent population-based cohort study in the U.S. associates untreated cavities with a 26 percent increased risk of all-cause mortality and a 48 percent increase in heart-disease mortality.2 Curodont® is designed as a non-invasive treatment intended to arrest or reverse early-stage cavities without drilling. Since its U.S. commercial launch in January 2024, vVARDIS estimates that Curodont® Repair Fluoride Plus has been used to treat over 3.5 million teeth and has been sold to over 20,000 of the approximately 110,000 general dental practices in the U.S., as of June 30, 2026.3

"Finding an early cavity and treating it should be one workflow, not two," said Haley Abivardi, DMD, co-CEO and co-founder of vVARDIS. “Dental teams want accurate information about their options for early-stage cavities, and patients want to understand the treatment they receive. This new functionality is another example of how technology is helping to create more efficiency in dental practices.”

"Our vision for Dentrix and Ascend is to bring intelligence directly into the clinical workflow, supporting clinicians without adding complexity. Auto-charting for the treatment of early-stage cavities is a great example of how we are connecting clinical insights, AI imaging, and documentation in a one click workflow to make technology work more simply for the dental team,” said April Lowry, Executive Director and General Manager, Clinical and AI, Henry Schein One.

This partnership promises to streamline access to drill-free dental solutions for patients across the United States.

“Dentrix and Ascend are part of the daily workflow for tens of thousands of U.S. practices,” said Greg Smith, Senior Vice President and General Manager, North America, vVARDIS. “We’re pleased to work with Henry Schein One to make information about Curodont® and drill-free treatment options for early-stage cavities more accessible to dental practices.”

Availability

Dentrix and Ascend are used in more than 75,000 locations in the United States. Auto-charting and the in-software Curodont® content are expected to become available within the next 30 days. vVARDIS and Henry Schein One plan to demonstrate the integration at the Greater New York Dental Meeting in New York City, November 29 to December 2, 2026.

About vVARDIS

vVARDIS () is a Swiss healthcare company in the dental med-tech sector headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, founded by Drs. Haley and Goly Abivardi, sisters, internationally renowned dentists and serial entrepreneurs. The company’s proprietary Curodont® technology platform offers an early therapeutic solution for tooth decay. Its flagship products are based on proprietary, peptide-containing formulations that complement the patient’s natural biology to help it stop the progression of early-stage cavities, preserve natural tooth structure and repair damaged enamel in early-stage cavities. Curodont®’s underlying technology is supported by a body of scientific evidence accumulated over the last 25 years, published in more than 250 publications, including randomized controlled trials, systematic reviews, meta-analyses and long-term real-world cohort analyses. Curodont® is featured in the curricula of over 50 U.S. and European dental programs. For more information, visit www.vVARDIS.com and ww.linkedin.com/company/vvardis.

About Henry Schein One

Henry Schein One, a global leader in dental technology, empowers dentists to focus on patient care and helps to ensure practice success. With simple and integrated technology, practices become more efficient, profitable, and connected—leading to better experiences for patients and care teams alike. The company’s comprehensive portfolio spans demand generation, patient experience, practice management, revenue cycle, analytics, and clinical workflow.

Henry Schein One, LLC, is a joint venture between Henry Schein, Inc. () and Internet Brands. Its brands include Dentrix, Ascend by Dentrix, Jarvis Analytics, TechCentral, Lighthouse360, and DentalPlans.com, as well as international brands such as Dentally and Software of Excellence.
